current_path.write_behavior: cache misses write through the /cargo WebDAV surface; writes are excluded from the zero-miss observation

observed_cost_model.interpretation: negative cache result remains visible: the warm lane was slower than the cold midpoint, and zero misses make write cost zero for this observation

acceptance.repository_gate: static source and arithmetic contract passes on ubuntu-24.04 without credentials or network
acceptance.production_measurement: six or more alternating paired cache-off/cache-on runs on one runner, revision, workload, and input set
acceptance.closure: keep B-105 open until the paired production receipt is linked and its result survives runner variance

invariants: the control and treatment must measure the same lane and input population
cache misses and cache writes are reported independently of cache-hit benefit
a zero-miss treatment contributes zero write cost; write-path fixes cannot explain that observation
the old hit-versus-compiler averages are not used because their populations were disjoint
a negative or indeterminate cache result is retained and cannot be relabeled as a pass
the repository gate never reads a PAT, tenant secret, provider state, or production endpoint
this contract does not enable the pilot, edit the campaign, generate load, or deploy

external_blocker.required_artifact: fresh redacted paired-lane receipt from the existing production evidence workflow
external_blocker.reason: repository-only evidence cannot establish whether the fixed product path beats cold compilation on a real runner

prohibited: closing B-105 from the static contract alone
claiming the 0.527/0.678 disjoint-population ratio is causal
assigning zero-miss slowdown to cache writes
adding a production credential to the repository
dispatching live load or deploying a Worker
editing campaign orchestration or unrelated backlog entries
